data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'arfa' which means 'exalted' or 'sublime'. This name signifies a gentle, elevated, and noble being. The name Arfah carries the meaning “Gentle, exalted one” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Arfah usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, exalted one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Arfah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gentle, exalted one.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Arfah total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
